title: liquiditybot — command
description: Condensed logistical command board: health, learning brain, positions, per-asset comparison, risk. Replaces the old multi-dashboard set.

panels.title: Bot
panels.description: runner_state == RUNNING.

panels.title: Status age
panels.description: Seconds since the last status write; climbs if the runner freezes.

panels.title: Cycle
panels.description: Fast-cycle counter since last restart (advancing = alive).

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: Account equity (cash + open uPnL).

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: Peak-to-now; 15% is the hard stop.

panels.title: Feed latency
panels.description: Kraken public-GET RTT EWMA (physical RTT).

panels.title: Open uPnL
panels.description: Unrealized P&L across open positions.

panels.title: Governor
panels.description: ML kill-switch: 0 OK / 1 degraded / 2 model killed.

panels.title: Entries
panels.description: New-risk entries enabled (exits always allowed).

panels.title: Halted
panels.description: Global halt flag.

panels.title: Kraken WS
panels.description: v2 book stream live vs REST fallback.

panels.title: Model in use
panels.description: Governor lets the model size trades (vs cold-start prior).

panels.title: Open risk
panels.description: $ lost if every open stop filled now.

panels.title: Gross exposure
panels.description: Gross notional %/equity vs the 35% heat cap.

panels.title: Live labels
panels.description: Ground-truth closed-trade labels — the ONLY thing that earns model complexity (evidence gate). This is the number to grow.

panels.title: Candidate labels
panels.description: Triple-barrier proxy labels (down-weighted, don't earn complexity).

panels.title: History rows
panels.description: Total training rows (live + candidate).

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Deployed rung on the simplicity ladder.

panels.title: Retrain queued
panels.description: Monitor has requested a retrain.

panels.title: Drift share
panels.description: Fraction of market features past the PSI threshold.

panels.title: Brier
panels.description: Rolling outcome Brier on the deployed model (lower better).

panels.title: Baseline Brier
panels.description: Base-rate Brier; model must beat this.

panels.title: Calibration gap
panels.description: |predicted - realized| ECE. Kelly consumes probs literally, so this must stay small.

panels.title: Champion Brier
panels.description: Deployed champion's OOF Brier badge.

panels.title: Kelly mult
panels.description: Governor size throttle (1.0 = full).

panels.title: Shrinkage
panels.description: Probability shrink toward base rate.

panels.title: Win rate
panels.description: Rolling closed-trade win rate.

panels.title: Win rate LCB
panels.description: Wilson lower bound — the honest floor.

panels.title: Profit factor
panels.description: Gross profit / gross loss.

panels.title: Expectancy R
panels.description: Avg trade in R-multiples.

panels.title: Net (window)
panels.description: Net realized over the rolling window.

panels.title: Trades
panels.description: Closed trades in the window.

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: One row per open instrument. Sorted by uPnL; watch R and stop distance for what to manage next.

panels.title: §4 · Per-asset comparison — where is the edge?
Asset scorecard
panels.description: Side-by-side, one row per asset. Concentration near 1 = a pinpointed setup (few strong factors); near 0 = a diffuse average. Compare win rate/net against confidence & concentration to see where conviction is actually paying — the input to session/asset weighting decisions.

panels.title: Loss streak (now)
panels.description: Consecutive losers now — the circuit-breaker input.

panels.title: Max loss streak
panels.description: Worst streak in the window.

panels.title: Model fallbacks
panels.description: Inference fell back to the prior.

panels.title: Infer faults
panels.description: Model inference errors.

panels.title: Contract fails
panels.description: Inference input outside contract.

panels.title: Retrain failures
panels.description: Auto-retrain crashed.

panels.title: Entry-decision reason codes
panels.description: Why entries were taken/vetoed (SZ/PT/QT families) — the most frequent code is what's gating the book right now.

panels.title: Gate weights (learned)
panels.description: Evidence-weighted contribution of each signal gate.
